title: What’s up,doc?
text:
Neha Bari.
    

    
      SUMMARY
      EXPERIENCE
      EDUCATION
    
  

  
    
      
        

        
          Hi, I am Neha! Welcome. My spirit cartoon is Bugs Bunny,
          and on this website I want to show my projects and side hobbies.
        

        
          EXPLORE MY WORK ↘
          
            SAY HI TO BUNNY ↗
          
        
      

      
        
        
        
          Eh… what’s up, doc?
        
      
    

    
      01 / SUMMARY
      Summary
      
        Data professional with experience developing data processing
        pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, and Azure Databricks,
        alongside machine learning modeling and validation through
        industry projects with Enexis, Philips, and TU Eindhoven.
      
      
        Motivated by building reliable, well-structured datasets that
        support business decisions. Experienced in translating stakeholder
        requirements into technical solutions, with previous experience
        supporting batch operations for Morgan Stanley.
      
    

    
      02 / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
      Professional Experience

      
        EngD – Data Science: Restaurant Digitalization (AI Waiter)
        TU Eindhoven · January 2025 – June 2026
        
          
            Gathered requirements through interviews with stakeholders
            from four restaurants and surveys of 65 customers, translating
            findings into 35 prioritized requirements.
          
          
            Developed a scheduled Azure Databricks workflow to validate
            221 simulated customer sessions for missing, duplicate,
            and invalid records.
          
          
            Stored validated data in Delta Lake and prepared structured
            datasets for order completion prediction.
          
          
            Developed and A/B tested ordering interface variants,
            using SQL to analyze order completion rates.
          
          
            Developed Logistic Regression and XGBoost models,
            achieving approximately 0.79 ROC AUC.
          
          
            Worked with data stewards on responsible handling of
            customer and restaurant data.
          
        
      

      
        
          EngD – Data Science: Intelligent Case Dispatching in Digital Pathology
        
        Philips · 2024–2025
        
          
            Managed the project in an Agile setup, coordinating with
            Philips’ Pathology team from data assessment to stakeholder
            recommendations.
          
          
            Assessed database schemas and data models, documenting
            six high-priority and five medium-priority data quality gaps.
          
          
            Integrated open-source datasets into Philips’ data schema,
            aligning case, pathologist, and tissue attributes with
            consistent business definitions.
          
          
            Explained data gaps and the attributes used by a model trained
            on open-source data to nontechnical stakeholders.
          
        
      

      
        EngD – Data Science: Infeed & Grid Loss Forecasting
        Enexis · 2024
        
          
            Collaborated with a lead Data Scientist to understand
            supplied datasets and clarify business requirements.
          
          
            Developed PySpark workflows in Azure Databricks to extract,
            transform, and prepare electricity load data for forecasting.
            Achieved a runtime of 1 minute and 2 seconds in the
            development environment.
          
          
            Engineered lag, rolling average, and calendar features using
            PySpark window functions and prepared Databricks feature tables.
          
          
            Used chronological training for a GRU model,
            achieving 7.63% MAPE.
          
        
      

      
        EngD – Data Science: AFib Detection on ECG
        Inno4Health · 2024
        
          
            Processed single-lead ECG recordings into 30-second windows
            and extracted time-domain features, identifying 21 features
            relevant to AFib detection.
          
          
            Worked in a five-person Agile team and discussed findings
            with stakeholders during weekly reviews.
          
        
      

      
        EngD – Data Science
        KNSB, Alliander & Omron · 2024
        
          
            Omron: Analyzed 42 stitching-machine sensor
            signals to identify equipment fault indicators for
            predictive maintenance.
          
          
            Alliander: Clustered 30,000 customer records
            into eight load-profile segments to estimate power
            requirements for new customers.
          
          
            KNSB: Led a team analyzing over 500,000 skating
            records, segmenting athletes by age and venue to compare
            engagement.
          
        
      

      
        Software Developer
        
          Tata Consultancy Services · Client: Morgan Stanley ·
          March 2016 – July 2018
        
        
          
            Supported production batch job migrations across regions,
            monitored execution against SLA windows, and reported
            failed or delayed runs.
          
        
      
    

    
      03 / SKILLS
      Skills

      
        Programming
        Python, SQL, PySpark

        Data Engineering
        
          Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL Pipelines,
          Data Transformation, Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD,
          Data Modeling, Model Monitoring, Agile/Scrum
        

        AI & Machine Learning
        XGBoost, GRU, LSTM
      
    

    
      04 / LANGUAGES
      Languages
      
        English
        Hindi
        Marathi
        Dutch — A1/A2
      
    

    
      05 / EDUCATION
      Education

      
        EngD Data Science (Contract)
        Eindhoven University of Technology · 2024–2026
      

      
        M.Sc. Computing Science
        Rijksuniversiteit Groningen · 2018–2021
      

      
        B.E. Computer Engineering
        Savitribai Phule Pune University · 2011–2015
      

      
        M.Sc. Thesis: Relevance Learning in Neuroimaging
        Rijksuniversiteit Groningen · 2021
        
          
            Integrated multicenter FDG PET data from three hospitals
            into a consistent dataset and corrected hospital-specific bias.
          
          
            Extended and evaluated a neural network classifier on
            175 cases, achieving approximately 85% AUROC,
            and assessed feature relevance.
          
        
      

      
        M.Sc. Internship: Hidden Unit Specialization in Neural Networks
        Rijksuniversiteit Groningen · 2020
        
          
            Investigated how dataset size and activation functions
            (ReLU versus Sigmoid) affected generalization and
            hidden unit specialization.
          
        
      
    

    
      06 / TRAINING & HACKATHONS
      Training & Hackathons

      
        Spring HPC School 2025
        
          Eindhoven Supercomputing Center · TU Eindhoven · April 2025
        
        Completed the Spring HPC School training program.
      

      
        Solve with Google Hackathon
        
          Participant · Team 3 · TU Eindhoven / JADS · April 2024
